passages.title: A Delightful Afternoon at Sweet Treats Bakery and Café
passages.titleVi: Một buổi chiều thú vị tại tiệm bánh và cà phê Sweet Treats
passages.text: Every Saturday afternoon, our family visits the Sweet Treats Bakery and Café in the center of town. The welcoming aroma of freshly baked goods fills the cozy room as smiling bakers greet local customers. In the front display case, an exquisite strawberry cake decorated with vanilla frosting attracts everyone's attention. The master baker explains that reducing refined sugar and using natural wildflower honey makes pastries both delicious and wholesome. On the wooden side counter, loaves of warm crusty bread sit alongside jars of homemade berry marmalade. Children stare with wide eyes at the vibrant candy jars filled with peppermint swirls and chewy caramels. Behind the counter, a glass shelf holds dark chocolate bars and freshly baked chocolate chip cookie platters. Our friendly server brings us a plate of crisp butter biscuit rounds and a bowl of crunchy potato chips for a savory contrast. For dessert, the café prepares a special campsite dessert using roasted marshmallows sandwiched between classic graham crackers. When you take a gentle bite of this warm treat, the melted layers blend together wonderfully. Enjoying these wholesome snacks with hot tea brings true relaxation after a busy school week. Learning to appreciate mindful eating and traditional baking methods strengthens family connections and creates lasting weekend memories. Before leaving, we purchased a loaf of seeded bread and a jar of clover honey to enjoy at home on Sunday morning. Sharing sweet delicacies with loved ones reminds us that simple treats can elevate everyday spirits. Whether dipping a crumbly biscuit into warm milk or savoring a morsel of fine chocolate, each moment offers joyful contentment. Walking back through the quiet neighborhood streets, we felt cheerful and refreshed.

Master pastry chefs prepare generous batches of fresh dough to bake golden butter cookies, flaky fruit pastries, and crispy almond biscuits. In the illuminated glass display case, rows of dark and creamy milk chocolate candies tempt eager neighborhood customers walking past the bright windows. To make each celebratory birthday cake truly memorable and festive, skilled decorators spread silky layers of colorful vanilla icing across delicate sponge layers. Some traditional recipes use fragrant floral honey and roasted nuts instead of refined white sugar to create a wholesome, satisfying afternoon snack. Inside the busy preparation kitchen, an electric countertop mixer whips fresh dairy cream and egg whites into fluffy, velvety clouds for gourmet desserts. Hungry visitors who enter the cheerful shop can choose from warm fruit tarts with a crunchy golden crust or bite-sized chocolate truffles dusted with fragrant cinnamon. Caring parents often purchase colorful sweet confections as a delightful weekend treat for their hardworking children after completing school projects. On festive seasonal holidays, creative confectioners carefully pipe intricate floral borders, sparkling stars, and personalized greeting messages using glossy royal icing. A piping hot cup of freshly brewed herbal tea or dark roasted espresso pairs delightfully with every buttery biscuit and freshly glazed snack. Local community members appreciate how artisanal pastry makers combine time-honored baking traditions with modern culinary design to brighten important family celebrations. Friendly bakers also offer complimentary tasting samples of new biscuit flavors, inviting shoppers to discover delightful flavor combinations every single week. Ultimately, whether sharing a grand anniversary cake with beloved relatives or savoring a single handmade chocolate treat, enjoying wholesome confections brings lasting comfort, warmth, and heartfelt joy to everyday life.

passages.title: Sharing Homemade Snacks at a Sunday Picnic
passages.text:
Every sunny Sunday afternoon in late autumn, four university roommates walk down to Willow Lake with a checkered wool blanket and a wicker basket full of homemade snacks and light sweets.

Before leaving their apartment at two o’clock, each friend prepares one simple treat to share together on the grass. Mei bakes warm oatmeal cookies dotted with dark raisins and crunchy walnuts, wrapping them carefully in clean wax paper so they stay soft. Nearby at the stove, David pops fresh yellow corn kernels in a heavy steel pot and shakes a pinch of fine sea salt over the crisp white popcorn. Meanwhile, Linh slices sweet ripe mangoes and packs crisp rice crackers into small reusable glass jars.

Once they spread the warm wool blanket beneath an old maple tree beside the quiet water, everyone opens a container and sets the treats in the center. Tasting homemade snacks together feels far healthier and warmer than buying noisy plastic bags from a hallway vending machine. When gentle breeze ripples across the lake, they pour chilled ginger tea into paper cups and trade cheerful stories about classes, weekend movies, and traditional family recipes from home. Even salty roasted almonds taste extra rich beside sweet tropical fruit and warm spiced cookies.

Before the orange sun drops behind the distant hills at five, not a single sweet crumb stays inside the wicker basket. Packing empty glass jars neatly back into their canvas tote bags, the four friends agree that simple afternoon snacks make ordinary Sundays feel like a cheerful mini-holiday by the peaceful lake.

passages.title: Packing Healthy Snacks for Long Study Days
passages.text:
Mid-afternoon hunger hits almost every busy student halfway through a long library study session or afternoon office shift. When your energy drops suddenly at three o clock, it feels very tempting to grab a sugary candy bar or salty fried chips from a hallway vending machine. However, sweet snacks packed with refined white sugar give only a short burst of energy before leaving you feeling sleepy and unfocused again thirty minutes later.

Preparing two simple balanced snacks in the early morning keeps your focus steady without blowing your weekly food budget. Pair natural fiber or slow-digesting whole grains with a source of crisp protein or healthy fat. Crisp red apple slices dipped into unsweetened peanut butter, or a small bowl of plain yogurt topped with fresh blueberries and crunchy sunflower seeds, satisfy cravings while releasing steady energy across the entire afternoon.

Portable snacks also work wonderfully when you travel between classes or catch an evening bus home. Roasted almonds, unsalted walnuts, crisp carrot sticks, and whole-grain crackers travel neatly inside small reusable glass or plastic containers without bruising or spilling inside a crowded backpack. Even a single square of dark chocolate beside a handful of dried apricots offers gentle natural sweetness without feeling overly heavy.

Finally, keep a full bottle of cool water within easy reach on your study desk, since mild thirst often disguises itself as snack hunger. By choosing fresh fruit, nuts, and lightly toasted seeds ahead of time, you avoid afternoon sugar crashes and stay sharp, cheerful, and productive right through your evening commute.

Cơn đói xế chiều ập đến với hầu hết mọi học sinh bận rộn vào giữa buổi tự học dài ở thư viện hay ca làm việc buổi chiều tại văn phòng. Khi năng lượng tụt dốc bất ngờ lúc ba giờ chiều, bạn rất dễ bị cám dỗ mua ngay một thanh kẹo ngọt gắt hay gói khoai tây chiên mặn từ máy bán hàng tự động ngoài hành lang. Tuy nhiên, đồ ăn vặt chứa nhiều đường trắng tinh luyện chỉ tạo ra nguồn năng lượng bùng lên chớp nhoáng trước khi khiến bạn lại rơi vào trạng thái buồn ngủ và mất tập trung chỉ ba mươi phút sau đó.

Chuẩn bị sẵn hai món ăn nhẹ cân bằng đơn giản vào sáng sớm giúp sự tập trung của bạn ổn định mà không làm thâm hụt ngân sách ăn uống hằng tuần. Hãy kết hợp chất xơ tự nhiên hoặc ngũ cốc nguyên hạt tiêu hóa chậm với một nguồn đạm nhẹ hay chất béo lành mạnh. Những lát táo đỏ giòn chấm bơ đậu phộng không đường, hoặc một hũ sữa chua nguyên vị rắc thêm việt quất tươi và hạt hướng dương bùi giòn sẽ xoa dịu cơn thèm ăn đồng thời giải phóng năng lượng đều đặn suốt cả buổi chiều.

Các món ăn nhẹ gọn nhẹ cũng rất tiện lợi khi bạn di chuyển giữa các lớp học hoặc bắt chuyến xe buýt tối về nhà. Hạnh nhân rang, quả óc chó không muối, cà rốt thái que giòn và bánh quy ngũ cốc nguyên hạt nằm gọn gàng trong những hộp tái sử dụng bằng thủy tinh hoặc nhựa nhỏ mà không bị dập hay đổ tràn trong ba lô đông đúc. Ngay cả một ô sô-cô-la đen nhỏ dùng cùng vài quả mơ sấy khô cũng mang lại vị ngọt tự nhiên dịu nhẹ mà không gây nặng bụng.

Cuối cùng, hãy để sẵn một bình nước mát ngay trong tầm tay trên bàn học, vì cảm giác khát nhẹ thường ngụy trang thành cơn thèm ăn vặt. Nhờ chuẩn bị trước trái cây tươi, các loại hạt và hạt rang nhẹ, bạn tránh được tình trạng tụt đường huyết buổi chiều và luôn tỉnh táo, vui vẻ, làm việc hiệu quả cho tới tận chuyến xe về nhà.
pronunciationNotesVi: Từ "almond" (/ˈɑl.mənd/ hoặc /ˈɑ.mənd/) thường đọc lướt hoặc câm nhẹ âm /l/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu.
Từ "chocolate" (/ˈtʃɑk.lət/) trong tiếng Anh Mỹ chỉ có 2 âm tiết "chawk-lit", tránh đọc kéo thành 3 âm tiết "chô-cô-lết".
Từ "yogurt" (/ˈjoʊ.ɡɚt/) mở đầu bằng âm /j/ như trong "yes" và nguyên âm đôi /oʊ/ rõ ràng.
Cụm "peanut butter" (/ˈpi.nʌt ˈbʌt.ɚ/) nối mượt mà; chữ "t" giữa trong "butter" đọc bật nhẹ thành âm vỗ lưỡi /t̬/ (gần giống chữ đ nhẹ) kiểu Mỹ.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why does the passage advise against relying on candy bars for afternoon study energy?
options: Refined sugar causes a quick burst followed by tiredness thirty minutes later.
Vending machines usually close inside public libraries after three o clock.
Candy bars always melt inside reusable backpack containers.
Salty fried chips provide zero flavor compared to sweet chocolate.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn đầu giải thích đồ ăn vặt nhiều đường tinh luyện chỉ giúp tăng năng lượng ngắn ngủi rồi khiến bạn buồn ngủ trở lại sau ba mươi phút.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What combination does the second paragraph recommend for steady afternoon focus?
options: Pairing natural fiber or slow carbs with protein or healthy fat.
Eating only sugary fruit juice before catching the evening bus.
Buying three salty snacks from a vending machine at noon.
Skipping breakfast completely so lunch feels more exciting.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn thứ hai khuyên nên kết hợp chất xơ tự nhiên hoặc tinh bột chậm với nguồn đạm hay chất béo tốt (như táo và bơ đậu phộng, sữa chua và hạt).

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why should you keep a full water bottle on your desk during study sessions?
options: Mild thirst often feels just like hunger for a snack.
Water dissolves crunchy sunflower seeds faster during breaks.
Every library requires students to carry sealed glass bottles.
Cold water turns plain yogurt into a frozen dessert.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn cuối nhắc nên giữ sẵn bình nước trên bàn vì cảm giác khát nhẹ thường dễ bị nhầm lẫn thành cơn đói thèm ăn vặt.
